director_name.description: The name of the Bacula Director instance.

director_port.description: The port the Director listens on for User Agent connections.

director_query_file.description: Path to the SQL query file for the Director.

director_working_directory.description: The working directory for Bacula Director.

director_pid_directory.description: The directory where the PID file is stored.

director_max_concurrent_jobs.description: Maximum number of concurrent jobs the Director can run.

client_fd_name.description: Name of the File Daemon client to backup.

catalog_name.description: Name of the Bacula catalog database resource.

restore_path.description: Path where files are restored for the RestoreFiles job.

default_fileset_include.description: Default directory included in the Full Set FileSet.

client_fd_address.description: Network address of the File Daemon client.

client_fd_port.description: Port the File Daemon listens on.

client_fd_password.description: Password for the File Daemon client.

client_fd_file_retention.description: Number of days to retain file information.

client_fd_job_retention.description: Number of months to retain job information.

storage_daemon_address.description: Network address of the Storage Daemon.

storage_daemon_port.description: Port the Storage Daemon listens on.

autochanger_max_concurrent_jobs.description: Maximum concurrent jobs for the virtual autochanger device.

catalog_db_password.description: Password for the Bacula database user.

mail_recipient.description: Email address for standard job messages.

operator_recipient.description: Email address for operator mount messages.

log_file.description: Path to the Bacula log file.

pool_volume_retention.description: Number of days to retain volumes in the pool.

pool_max_volume_bytes.description: Maximum size of a volume in the pool.

pool_max_volumes.description: Maximum number of volumes in the pool.
